items.stem: Which TWO signals should production model monitoring track beyond uptime? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Input data drift versus the training distribution
options.rationale: Correct: data drift warns that inputs have changed.

options.text: Model prediction quality or a proxy for it over time
options.rationale: Correct: degrading quality is a key signal.

options.text: The number of comments in the code

items.stem: Why is a model registry with versioning valuable in an MLOps pipeline?

options.text: It tracks which model version is deployed and enables controlled rollback
options.rationale: Correct: a registry records versions and supports safe promotion/rollback.
A registry stores and tracks models; it does not train them.

options.text: It removes the need for monitoring

options.rationale: Drift can still occur; the registry does not prevent it.
